structured_output.what_is_happening: "Fred" is a token 38 minutes old. It launched on a Meteora virtual curve and migrated right away, and it trades on PumpSwap plus two other pairs. In its first half hour it went from launch to an all-time-high market cap of about $741k, then crashed. At detection the price was about 78% below that high: -68.67% over 5 minutes on DexScreener, around $165k market cap. Volume is extreme: $2.63M in one hour on $41k of liquidity, so the whole pool turned over about 63 times. Only 86 unique sellers against 1,328 unique buyers across more than 4,500 sells points to heavy repeat or bot selling by a small group of wallets. GMGN flags 49 bundler wallets. The linked sources are one X post (tolgakasap1) and a Reddit r/antiai thread titled "new meme just dropped and his name is Fred". At least 8 other Fred tokens were launched in the last few hours.

narrative.description: A new meme character called 'Fred' from an anti-AI Reddit post, possibly tied to the Fred the Raccoon or raccoon meme family. It is a fresh internet meme with some organic origin, and several same-name launches are chasing it.
narrative.why_spreading: A new meme posted on Reddit and X set off a launch race across many Fred tickers. This token won the first attention wave, peaking at about $741k, but the sharp retrace suggests the first wave is done.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has by far the most volume and liquidity of the fresh Fred launches, and GMGN links it to the source tweet and the Reddit post, so right now it is the de facto leader.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are at least 8 same-name Fred tokens. DLffJ… launched about 5 minutes before this one and did $311k of volume in an hour. Others include 6aVMo…pump, Dr3FF…, CQwC8…, FLcLW… (Fred the Raccoon) and 12CwT… (RacoonWifHat). An older FRED (First Convicted RACCON) has $307k of liquidity. The name is split heavily across these tokens.

authenticity.evidence: About 1,328 unique buyers suggests real retail interest. But only 86 unique sellers produced about 4,500 sells, which is concentrated extraction, and GMGN tags 49 bundler wallets. There is no paid DexScreener promotion or profile. The creator's account is closed, and the creator's other token reached a $741k ATH.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X data. I can't see how big the Reddit or X meme actually is, or whether a larger account is pushing it.

structural_risks: Price is already down about 78% from the ATH, and early holders and bundlers are distributing
A single unlabeled wallet holds 80%. It is probably a Meteora pool, but that isn't confirmed
RugCheck flags 0% LP locked on one of the top markets and a low number of LP providers, while GMGN reports lp_burn_ratio 1.0. The two sources conflict
Only 86 sellers accounted for all the sell volume, which points to bot or insider churn
The ticker is split across many copycat Fred tokens

structured_output.counterargument: Fresh meme coins often bounce 2-3x after a first crash of around 78%. The ATH was about 4.5x the current price, so going back to $330k only needs a partial retrace. GeckoTerminal already shows the last 5 minutes flat (+1.2%) with buyers still well ahead of sellers. If the Reddit meme spreads on X, this token is the liquid leader and would get the flow.
unknowns: Who holds the 80% wallet: a pool or an insider
Whether the LP on the 0%-locked market can be pulled
How far the Fred meme is actually spreading on X and Reddit
The price path in the 25 minutes before entry

source_coverage.notes: No internet in this condition. The assessment uses only the evidence packet.

structured_output.thesis: This is a launch-race meme coin that has already had its main pump (about $741k ATH) and is now being distributed: 86 sellers, 49 bundlers, and a 68% drop in 5 minutes. Doubling from here within 6 hours would need a second attention wave while many Fred copycats compete for the same buyers. That is possible but not the likely outcome, and fading or dying is more likely.
